source.name: PR Newswire / SailGP - ROCKWOOL renews multi-year commitment to SailGP to 2032, marking league's longest-standing team partnership
source.quote: ROCKWOOL has renewed its multi-year commitment to SailGP, extending its title partnership of the Danish-flagged ROCKWOOL Racing SailGP Team through to the end of 2032.

note: Title partnership running since 2019, renewed 27 November 2025 through the end of 2032; Sportcal reported the same terms ('for the next seven years'). Since February 2026 the team is owned and operated by American Magic, with ROCKWOOL continuing as Title Partner (americanmagic.com, 2026-02-12). No deal value reported.
